mapper.select: SELECT id, status, sign_key_id, sign_key_version, sign_attempt_no, vc_jws_header, vc_jws_payload, vc_payload FROM tb_credentials WHERE id = #{credentialId}

SELECT co.institution_id::text FROM tb_credentials c JOIN tb_credential_groups g ON g.id = c.credential_group_id JOIN tb_completions cp ON cp.id = g.completion_id JOIN tb_enrollments e ON e.id = cp.enrollment_id JOIN tb_courses co ON co.id = e.course_id WHERE c.id = #{credentialId}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_credentials SET sign_key_id = #{signKeyId}, sign_key_version = #{signKeyVersion}, vc_jws_header = #{encodedHeader}, vc_jws_payload = #{encodedPayload}, sign_attempt_no = 1, issuer_identifier = #{issuerIdentifier}, subject_identifier = #{subjectIdentifier}, valid_from = #{issuedAt}, issued_at = #{issuedAt}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{credentialId} AND status = 'ISSUING' AND vc_payload IS NULL AND vc_jws_header IS NULL
